capabilities: Insert self-sorting task blocks wrapped in %% tasks %% markers
Stamp created, completion and cancelled dates as inline fields
Sort tasks open, completed, then cancelled, with optional section titles
Add tasks via a button, commands, or Enter on an existing task
Configure date format, button labels and per-block overrides
extras: Stores everything as plain Markdown checkboxes and inline fields written to the note, so files stay organized without the plugin; no network access.
problem: Obsidian's task lists are plain checkboxes with no automatic date stamps or sorting, so task lists in notes get disorganized over time.
summary: Task manager that keeps self-sorting task blocks in notes, stamping created, completion and cancelled dates as inline fields.
